question_text: If A, B, C are the angles of a triangle and x = cis A, y = cis B, z = cis C, then find the value of xyz.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find xyz — what happens to the angles when cis numbers are multiplied, and what the triangle tells you.
insider_note: The phrase 'angles of a triangle' is the given fact: A + B + C = 180°, so xyz = cis 180° = −1. The first mark is for writing that angle sum down; without it only the second mark is earned.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Product of cis is cis of the sum
steps.margin_note: First mark. Multiplying cis numbers adds the angles, so xyz = cis(A + B + C), and in a triangle A + B + C = 180°. Both lines have to be on the page.
lines: xyz = cis A · cis B · cis C = cis(A + B + C)

recall.must_convey: That cis A · cis B · cis C = cis(A + B + C), and that A + B + C = 180° in a triangle.
accept: the product of cis A cis B cis C is cis of A plus B plus C, and the angles of a triangle add to one eighty
multiply the three and the angles add, giving cis one eighty degrees
x y z is cis of the sum of the angles which is one eighty
cis multiply cheste angles add avuthai, triangle lo A plus B plus C one eighty
the angles add when cis numbers are multiplied
heard_as: cis A plus B plus C

steps.why: Multiplying cis numbers adds their angles (the moduli are all 1). The triangle fact A + B + C = 180° is the only other input, and it is why the question says 'angles of a triangle'.
common_mistakes: Multiplying the angles instead of adding them.
Expanding each cis into cos and sin and multiplying three brackets.

steps.label: Evaluate cis 180°
steps.margin_note: Second mark. cos 180° = −1 and sin 180° = 0, so xyz = −1 + i(0) = −1. Write the i(0) to show the imaginary part was checked.

recall.must_convey: That the reduced expression is evaluated to −1.
accept: evaluate the reduced form and get −1
simplify the powers of omega and the value is −1

steps.why: cos 180° = −1 and sin 180° = 0, so cis 180° is −1. Writing the i(0) shows the imaginary part was not forgotten.
common_mistakes: Leaving the answer as cos 180° + i sin 180° without evaluating.
